subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Preterm labour, PROM and post-term: steroids, magnesium and induction

steps.tx: **Preterm labour** (**20 to 37 weeks**, contractions with cervical change; infection, PPROM, twins, polyhydramnios, short cervix, prior preterm) with **fibronectin** (negative rules out) and **cervical length** (under 25 mm rescues cerclage history) predicts; **progesterone** (vaginal short cervix, 17P prior preterm) prevents. Bed rest useless; hydration antibiotics selected.
steps.say: Painful regular cervix opening before 37 is preterm: short cervix progesterone cerclage history prevents. Rest useless.

steps.tx: **Steroids** (**betamethasone 12 mg IM 2 doses 24 hours**, dexamethasone 6 mg 4 doses; **24 to 34 weeks**, late preterm 34 to 36 selected; RDS IVH NEC death cut, **single course**, repeat selected) with **magnesium neuroprotection** (**4 g load 1 g hourly**, cerebral palsy cut, distinct from seizure doses) and **tocolysis** (**nifedipine** first, atosiban costly, indomethacin ductus oligohydramnios, **48 hours** steroids transfer) buys time. Antibiotics PPROM prolong.
steps.say: Steroids single course 24 34 lungs save; magnesium drips brains spare. Tocolysis 48 hours transfers.

steps.tx: **PROM** (**pooling, ferning, nitrazine**, IGFBP PAMG-1; **latency antibiotics** erythromycin, **delivery 34 weeks** PPROM, expectant 34 to 37 GBS negative, immediate chorioamnionitis abruption nonreassuring) with **chorioamnionitis** (fever tachycardia uterine tenderness foul liquor, ampicillin gentamicin, **deliver promptly**) complicates; cord prolapse (knee chest, fill bladder, section) emergencies. Sterile speculum diagnoses.
steps.say: Gushing pooling ferning nitrazine is PROM: erythromycin latencies 34 delivers. Fever tender foul delivers now.

steps.tx: **Post-term** (**beyond 42 weeks**, **41 weeks induce** stillbirth rise, dysmaturity, macrosomia shoulder, oligohydramnios meconium; **membrane sweep**, **dinoprostone**, **Foley**, oxytocin Bishop) with **surveillance** (CTG, liquor, Doppler) induces; dates first trimester crown rump lock. Macrosomia sections selected; meconium teams attend suctioning while shoulder dystocia drills stay ready.
steps.say: Beyond 42 risks stillbirth: 41 induces sweeps Foley prostins. Dates locked first trimester.
